mechanism: Propylthiouracil may increase systemic corticosteroid effects and budesonide metabolism is minimally affected, but concurrent use in hyperthyroidism management requires monitoring as thyroid status affects corticosteroid clearance and efficacy.
action: Monitor thyroid function tests and clinical response to both medications; adjust corticosteroid dosing based on thyroid status changes as propylthiouracil normalizes thyroid hormone levels.
